positions.title: Application Developer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · On-site
positions.description:
Built Custody Billing Software for Institutional, Broker dealers, Insurance, Hedge Funds, and large private asset Manager. 
Performed a leading role to Generate Reporting pipeline tool to support increasing demand for ad hoc requests. Converted old AS400 system to New C++/Java OOP based robust system. (per day data volume about 1 to 2T Byte)  Trained and managed Outsource India team for EMEA clients.
Wrote numerous store procedures, sqls, Triggers, Index, Performance tuning enhancement and scheduled to MDM queue for automation. 
Unit, regression and smoke manual test for small to large functionality, and created customize JIRA tool to keep track Defects and scrum calls.
Built small sets of WPF/Console Applications in VB/ Access, Excel Add-in Macro, ODBCs to move data from large scale SQL Server to Individual Desktop Installation.
